reviewer: Playfield design chat, self-review; coordinator portfolio review remains separate
inspectionScope: All fifteen three-device boards for composition/reflow; listed individual screens for readable native text, countable contents, fields, sums and sequence. Very tall images may be downscaled by the inspection transport; source/PNG geometry and exact pixel dimensions are independently checked. No claim of human user testing or full accessibility conformance.

residualLimits: Fixture interaction and artifact checks do not establish production commerce, identity, provider, tenant or persistence behavior.

Actual credentials, bot challenge, identity-issued session, explicit OAuth Continue and payment eligibility require implementation acceptance; separate optional email verification is not a mandatory BuyerAuthorize transition.
Product links in this bounded storybook share one reference PDP; production needs real per-product routes.
Warnings and policies require merchant source/ownership. No actual material-finish specification or live shipping/returns policy exists in the synthetic catalog.
Screen-reader use, merchant-language usability, complete keyboard journey and real-device/network performance remain implementation acceptance.
